    10 | ## 1. Overview
    11 | 
    12 | This contract defines the unified communication protocol layer that abstracts CAN bus, RS485, and EtherCAT for all MyActuator motor series. The Protocol Abstraction Layer (PAL) provides a consistent interface regardless of the underlying transport.
    13 | 
    14 | ### 1.1 Supported Protocols
    15 | 
    16 | | Protocol | Profile | Default Configuration |
    17 | |----------|---------|----------------------|
    18 | | CAN bus | ISO 11898-1 | 500kbps, 29-bit extended IDs |
    19 | | RS485 | Modbus RTU | 115200 baud, 8N1 |
    20 | | EtherCAT | CoE (CANopen over EtherCAT) | 1ms cycle time, DC sync |
    21 | 
    22 | ### 1.2 Protocol Auto-Detection
    23 | 
    24 | The system supports automatic protocol detection and fallback:
    25 | 
    26 | 1. **Boot Sequence:** Try CAN → RS485 → EtherCAT
    27 | 2. **Heartbeat Monitoring:** Each protocol has a heartbeat mechanism
    28 | 3. **Fallback Trigger:** If heartbeat fails for 3 consecutive cycles, switch to next protocol
    29 | 4. **Manual Override:** Build flag `-DPROTOCOL_CAN` (or RS485/ETHERCAT) forces specific protocol
    30 | 
    31 | ---
    32 | 
    33 | ## 2. Protocol Abstraction Layer (PAL)
    34 | 
    35 | ### 2.1 Unified Interface
    36 | 
    37 | ```cpp
    38 | class IProtocol {
    39 | public:
    40 |     virtual ~IProtocol() = default;
    41 |     
    42 |     // Connection management
    43 |     virtual bool connect() = 0;
    44 |     virtual void disconnect() = 0;
    45 |     virtual bool isConnected() const = 0;
    46 |     
    47 |     // Data transfer
    48 |     virtual bool send(const Frame& frame) = 0;
    49 |     virtual bool receive(Frame& frame, uint32_t timeout_ms = 100) = 0;
    50 |     
    51 |     // Status
    52 |     virtual ProtocolType getType() const = 0;
    53 |     virtual uint32_t getLastError() const = 0;
    54 |     virtual uint32_t getRetryCount() const = 0;
    55 | };
    56 | ```
    57 | 
    58 | ### 2.2 Protocol Implementations
    59 | 
    60 | - `CanProtocol` - CAN bus implementation
    61 | - `ModbusProtocol` - RS485/Modbus RTU implementation
    62 | - `EthercatProtocol` - EtherCAT implementation
    63 | 
    64 | ---
    65 | 
    66 | ## 3. Message Frame Format
    67 | 
    68 | ### 3.1 Unified Frame Structure (64 bytes)
    69 | 
    70 | ```
    71 | ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    72 | │ Header (8 bytes)                                                │
    73 | ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    74 | │ Motor ID (1 byte)                                               │
    75 | ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    76 | │ Command Type (1 byte)                                           │
    77 | ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    78 | │ Sequence Number (1 byte)                                        │
    79 | ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    80 | │ Payload (32 bytes)                                              │
    81 | ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    82 | │ CRC-16/CCITT Checksum (2 bytes)                                 │
    83 | ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    84 | │ Padding (19 bytes)                                              │
    85 | └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
    86 | ```
